title: Quadrilobate
summary: QUAD'RILOBATE, QUAD'RILOBED, adjective [Latin quadra, or quatuor, four, and lobe, Gr.] In botany, having four lobes; as a quadrilobed leaf.

inlines.v: QUAD'RILOBATE, QUAD'RILOBED, adjective [Latin quadra, or quatuor, four, and lobe, Gr.] In botany, having four lobes; as a quadrilobed leaf.
